settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationPreview: Show the message text in notifications
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the notification area when the window is closed
settings.closeToTray@mac: Keep running in the menu bar when the window is closed
settings.startAtSignIn: Start TwoTicks when I sign in
settings.speaker: Speaker
settings.logOutText: This unlinks the PC from your phone and deletes the messages and files stored on it. They stay on your phone.
settings.logOutText@unix: This unlinks the computer from your phone and deletes the messages and files stored on it. They stay on your phone.
settings.cannotUpdate: This copy was not installed with the setup program, so it cannot update itself. New versions are on GitHub.
settings.cannotUpdate@unix: TwoTicks tells you about new versions but does not install them here. New versions are on GitHub.
settings.aboutText: A native WhatsApp app for Windows. It links to your phone the way WhatsApp Web does: the phone keeps your account, and this PC is one of its linked devices.
settings.aboutText@unix: A native WhatsApp app for Windows, macOS and Linux. It links to your phone the way WhatsApp Web does: the phone keeps your account, and this computer is one of its linked devices.
settings.sourceCode: Source code and releases on GitHub
settings.disclaimerAffiliation: TwoTicks is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. The name WhatsApp, its logo, emoji, icons and wallpapers belong to them.
settings.disclaimerRisk: WhatsApp has no public API for personal accounts. Using a client WhatsApp did not make is against its terms of service, and WhatsApp can ban accounts for it. Bans of accounts that only chat normally are rare, but you use TwoTicks at your own risk.
settings.disclaimerLicenses: TwoTicks talks to WhatsApp with whatsmeow, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Its font is Roboto, by Google, under the Apache License 2.0.
